title: Cycling’s Lactate Superfuel Has Caused so Much Hype Riders are Sidestepping Sponsors to Get It
content:
Lactate gels are being sold in 'anonymized' packaging as demand for next-gen fuel used by Pogačar and Tour de France teams explodes.

Read the full article at Cycling’s Lactate Superfuel Has Caused so Much Hype Riders are Sidestepping Sponsors to Get It on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
